prose:
TLDR links a report titled Amazon Nearing $7.5 Billion Purchase of Decart. The supplied Information page was inaccessible, so this entry records the headline's prospective deal claim without reconstructing terms.

A later Bloomberg item separately reports an agreement to acquire much of Decart's technology and team, rather than establishing a purchase of the entire company. That later entry is the better source for the subsequently reported stage. Neither headline alone proves closing, the final consideration or the scope of retained assets. These are related reports on one transaction, not two separate acquisitions.
highlights: Nearing is a prospective stage, not closing
A later Bloomberg report describes technology and team scope
The two reports concern the same transaction
